name: richos-phone-probe
description: The half-day device probe from docs/plans/richos-phone-client-2026-09-18.md §3.2 — six checks on the CEO's iPhone, one page, served by his own Mac over a certificate his own Mac minted.
comment:dependencies: EMPTY ON PURPOSE, and four separate packages' worth of it. Node's own crypto covers ECDH P-256, HKDF-SHA256, AES-128-GCM and both signature forms, so web push (RFC 8291 + RFC 8292, lib/webpush.js) and X.509 issuance (lib/der.js + lib/x509.js) need no package; zlib covers PNG (lib/png.js); and the QR encoder (lib/qr.js) is arithmetic. Each is checked against a published value rather than against itself — RFC 8291's own test vector, Apple's trust evaluator, ISO/IEC 18004 Annex I and Apple's Vision decoder. The reasoning is at the top of each file.
